main_text.p: & subiecta cernitur,nam certū est eiusmodi ventos multa sæpe inquinamenta & sparsa[?] morborum femina ex meridionalib? illis regionibus & locis huc depōhere[?], quæ postea in cauitatibus inclufa, atq; retenta rationem habét causæ efficientis & procreantis morbi, vt extrinsecus accidétia, & in corpore nostro non sponte generata. Ego, vt ab eiusmodi cō- tagione perstē irimmunis;itinerib?,crebro ex- ércitio, vel subdialibus montanisq; inambu- lationibus, Septentriones versus vel Orienté corpus soleo ventilare & perspirabile redde- ste, ex quib. postea me bené habere & valere testantur viri & amici optimi, eundé in finé id mecum ex suasu meo pertentantes. Hactenus de essentia aeris, Sequitur eius qualitas:

Hæc non minus ad sanitatem tuendam,Qualitā- tes aeris, morborum; præcautionem conferr, quam ipsius essentia:earum Effectus. Aer enim calidus confert frigido tempe- mento prædicitis, affectibusq; frigidis & diu- turnis: frigidus calidis, humidus siccis, ficcus- que humidis opportune est accommodand?.

Praeterea cōmoda & incomoda adnotare coducit,que vnaquæq; aeris qualitas secū af- ferre consueuit:NB. Calidus aer corpora langui- diora reddit,breuiorisq; vitæ. Calorem n.in- satum & fluentem à centro ad circumferen- tiā educendo citius refoluit,cordiq; incomo- dat & morbis calidis, sed frigidis congruus est cerebrumq; recreat, & refocillat. Fri-

page.notes: Left-margin notes transcribed as printed; their placement beside the lines is approximate. Several words are uncertain (sparsa, depohere, and the wording of the last lines of the page, such as "Calorem n.in-", "satum", "dat" and "sed frigidis congruus"), where the scan is faint or the type is damaged. The notes "Qualitā- tes aeris" and "earum Effectus." are read from the margin; the first is hyphenated across two lines in print. The page ends mid-word ("Fri-"), which is kept as printed. Show-through from the reverse side is ignored.
